expectations.text: Recommends a custom method (not standard create/update)
Path is scoped under the User resource (orgs/{org}/users/{user} or users/{user})
expectations.evidence: Path is /v1/users/{userId}:suspend — flat under /users, NOT scoped under Org despite Org being a stated resource

expectations.text: Input is minimal (just the resource name/path params, no resource body)
expectations.evidence: SuspendUserInputSchema has userId, reason, note, notifyUser, effectiveAt — no full User body

expectations.text: Output returns the updated User resource (not void / not an Operation for a sync action)
expectations.evidence: SuspendUserOutputSchema wraps user + revokedSessionCount + notificationSent + suspendedAt — creates a custom response shape instead of returning the User resource directly (violates AIP-121 schema consistency)

expectations.text: Explanation cites AIP-130 (or general reasoning about standard vs custom methods)
expectations.evidence: Cites Google AIP-136, AIP-134, AIP-158; general reasoning about custom vs standard is present

expectations.text: Verb is camelCase imperative (suspend, suspendUser, or similar — not snake_case or kebab-case)
